assessment_objectives.objective: Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) practices require the removal and prohibition of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are designated as supply chain threats by a statutory or regulatory body.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: the removal timeframe specified by the applicable statutory or regulatory designation, and no longer than the shortest applicable compliance deadline

assessment_objectives.objective: Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) practices require the removal and prohibition of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are designated as supply chain threats by an internally performed risk assessment.
